blocks.text: Kingdom Academy: Shaping High School Education in Huntsville, Alabama
Kingdom Academy ✦ 9th-12th Grade ✦
9th-12th Grade
Kingdom Academy empowers 9th-12th graders to pursue God’s calling with confidence .
Empower your child for success and significance.

The Kingdom Academy at Kingdom Heights Preparatory School is a transformative high school experience designed to prepare 9th-12th grade students for college, the workforce, or the military while equipping them to serve and build God’s Kingdom in every sphere of society.

Our Christ-centered curriculum, career readiness programs, entrepreneurship opportunities, STEAM focus, and leadership opportunities ensure that students graduate with the skills, knowledge, and character needed to thrive in life and purposefully impact the world.
Give Them More Than a Diploma.
Prepare your student for college, career, and Kingdom impact.
Why Kingdom Academy ?
High school is more than academics—it’s a time to shape character, deepen faith, and prepare for life beyond graduation.
In Kingdom Academy, we provide:
Rigorous, Christ-Centered Academics: A challenging curriculum that equips students with critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills, all taught through the lens of biblical truth.
Leadership Development: Students collaborate, create, and lead, gaining confidence and skills to serve as Christ-like leaders in any setting.
Career Readiness: Through STEAM education, internships, and hands-on learning, students explore future careers and develop real-world skills.

Senior Capstone Project: Every senior completes a culminating project, presenting either a traditional senior thesis before a panel of university professors or launching a global business idea before a panel of business leaders.
Economics & Personal Finance: We equip students to manage God’s resources wisely, preparing them for financial independence and stewardship.
Faith in Action: Weekly chapel, discipleship opportunities, and community service projects encourage students to live out their faith boldly.
Discover how Kingdom Academy prepares students for life and eternity.
Academics: A Curriculum That Prepares for College, Career & Life
Deepening understanding of Scripture and applying biblical principles to daily life.
Building strong communication skills through reading , writing , and critical analysis .
Strengthening logical reasoning and problem-solving abilities .
Encouraging curiosity through hands-on experiments.
Exploring history, culture, and citizenship from a biblical worldview.

At Kingdom Academy, students gain practical financial literacy through our Economics course, learning to manage God’s resources wisely. From budgeting and investing to understanding global markets, students develop the skills to make sound financial decisions while exploring how biblical stewardship shapes economic choices.

Our U.S. Government course equips students to become engaged citizens, understanding the foundations of American democracy, civic responsibility, and the biblical principles that shaped our nation. Students explore the Constitution, branches of government, and current events, developing the skills to lead and advocate with integrity.

The Health course at Kingdom Academy empowers students to make wise choices for their physical, mental, and emotional well-being. From nutrition and fitness to mental health awareness, students develop a Christ-centered understanding of holistic health, preparing them for lifelong wellness.

blocks.text: Kingdom Academy offers a range of electives to cultivate creativity, career readiness, and global awareness. Students can explore the arts through music, theater, and visual design, develop technical skills in STEAM fields, or pursue world languages, including Latin, to enhance communication and cultural literacy.

Senior Capstone Project:
Preparing for What’s Next
The Senior Capstone Project is a defining moment for Kingdom Academy students. Seniors choose one of two paths:
Traditional Senior Thesis: Present a research-based thesis before a panel of university professors , demonstrating intellectual rigor , critical thinking , and effective communication .
Global Business Project: Develop and pitch a business idea to a panel of industry leaders , gaining real-world experience in entrepreneurship and problem-solving .
This project ensures students graduate ready for college, career, or military service.
Spiritual Formation & Leadership Development

In Kingdom Academy, we believe high school is about more than academics—it's a time to develop spiritual maturity, strong character, and Christ-centered leadership. Our program equips students to lead with integrity and serve others faithfully, both now and in the future.
Through Kingdom Academy, students engage in:

items: Bible Classes: Daily instruction rooted in Scripture, teaching Christian values while encouraging deep, personal faith
Mentorship: One-on-one guidance from Christ-centered leaders, offering personalized support in both spiritual growth and life skills
Chapel Services: Weekly worship, prayer, and biblical teaching, creating space for reflection, discipleship, and spiritual renewal
Community Service: Opportunities to serve locally and globally, encouraging students to live out their faith through hands-on service

blocks.text: Empower your child to grow in faith and lead with purpose.
ROYAL HOUR
Character & Leadership Development

At Kingdom Heights, we don’t just educate, we equip future leaders . Our students are encouraged to grow spiritually, academically, and socially. We foster biblical character traits like integrity, humility, resilience, and compassion.

Royal Hour: Each day, students participate in Royal Hour , a dedicated time for tutoring, enrichment, or extracurricular clubs . This encourages students to take ownership of their education , explore interests, and seek help when needed.
Empower your child to thrive.
Standards-Based Grading & Limited Homework

At Kingdom Heights, we believe education should be progress-driven, not pressure-driven . Our standards-based grading approach ensures students advance only when they’ve mastered each concept . If a student needs more time, they receive personalized support without falling behind. Likewise, students ready to move ahead can progress without unnecessary repetition.
We also believe in protecting family time . That’s why homework is limited , ensuring evenings are spent connecting, creating, and resting , not stressing over assignments.
Learn how we balance academic success and family life.
Tuition & Discounts

items: Multi-Student Discount: $250 off for the second child, $500 for the third, and $1,000 for the fourth or more
Full Payment Discount: 5% off total tuition for families paying in full
Active Military Discount: 10% off for active-duty military families
